name: overheard-help
about: Chopping wood, the character overhears a stranger in global chat ask anyone for help at the red obelisk ("red ob"), without its name. It finds the obelisk on the map, says it is coming, and goes.

world.about: A survival game in the manner of ARK on a real-scale coast: survivors gather, craft, build bases and tame or fight dinosaurs, many of which hunt people. The other survivors are real players; everyone talks in global, local and tribe chat. Three huge obelisks, red, green and blue, are seen from anywhere.

places.name: red obelisk
places.about: the red obelisk: a spire towering over the land, seen from anywhere

prompt: You are Scout, a survivor. Chop wood nearby for a while.
